answer: Twenty-seven cloned badges were booking night shifts at the cooperative metalworks from one locker. An applicant now escrows 16,800 units for 54 hours, then works bay 11 of the riverside forge during a logged 22-minute gale that must average 14.6 m/s on anemometer A3, and quenches a 0.40 kg test bar whose grain kernel is photographed at 40x and hashed to the registered coupon. If the wind traces diverge by more than 8 percent, or the same badge retries inside 36 hours, 55 percent of the escrow is burned and the bay is sealed for 11 days.
